## Task task-18b7ca7d
Observed rule from two demos and confirmed test: shift the entire grid contents down by exactly one row. Discard the original bottom row; fill the new top row using the background color (the color occurring in the empty/background cells).

- Demo 1: 3x3 mostly 5, lone 0 at row 1 col 2 moves to row 2 col 2; top row stays background.

- Test solved correctly by placing a full background row at top and copying original rows 0–2 into output rows 1–3.
